description: This file contains C code implementations for parsing, formatting, and manipulating HTTP date strings according to RFC standards, including functions to parse various date formats, convert date strings to time structures, and generate date strings from time values.

methods.name: __attribute_cold__ const char * http_date_parse_RFC_850(const char * s,struct tm * const tm)
methods.description: Parses RFC 850 date format strings into a struct tm, handling two-digit years with logic to interpret dates correctly over a century boundary.

methods.name: __attribute_cold__ const char * http_date_parse_asctime(const char * const s,struct tm * const tm)
methods.description: Parses asctime() style date strings into a struct tm.

methods.name: const char * http_date_parse_IMF_fixdate(const char * const s,struct tm * const tm)
methods.description: Parses IMF-fixdate formatted strings into a struct tm.

methods.name: const char * http_date_str_to_tm(const char * const s,const uint32_t len,struct tm * const tm)
methods.description: Attempts to parse a date string in various formats (RFC, RFC 850, asctime) into a struct tm.

methods.name: uint32_t http_date_time_to_str(char * const s,const size_t sz,const unix_time64_t t)
methods.description: Converts a unix timestamp to a standardized IMF-fixdate string.

methods.name: int http_date_if_modified_since(const char * const ifmod,const uint32_t ifmodlen,const unix_time64_t lmtime)
methods.description: Checks if a resource has been modified since a provided date string, returning appropriate status.
